library
  api (backend, hono)
    authors: Author
      GET /authors
      GET /authors/[id]
      POST /authors
      PATCH /authors/[id]
      DELETE /authors/[id]
      GET /authors/[id]/books
    books: Book
      GET /books
      GET /books/[id]
      POST /books
      PATCH /books/[id]
      DELETE /books/[id]
  web (frontend, nextjs) uses api
    /authors: list of AuthorCard
    /authors/[id]: AuthorView
    /books: list of BookCard
    /books/new: form books.create, then /books
    AuthorCard(author: Author)
      shows: author.name, author.born
      links to /authors/[id]
    AuthorView(author: Author)
      shows: author.name, author.born, author.books as chips
    BookCard(book: Book)
      shows: book.title, book.author, book.genre, book.published, book.in_print
  data (2 entities)
    Author
    Book
